added.title: The Man in the Wall
added.prompt:
A monumental, identity-locked photorealistic sculpture installation.

SUBJECT: A colossal, hyper-realistic portrait sculpture of the specific man from the reference photo (image_0.png). The identity is paramount, featuring his exact facial structure, nose shape, high cheekbones, strong jawline, and preserved detailed skin texture, maintaining his youth.

EXPRESSION: His face has a distinct, subtle, and controlled smirk—a knowing, closed-mouth expression that is mischievous and slightly sinister, but is a direct extension of his original jaw and mouth structure, not a distorted broad grin. His direct, intense brown eyes are perfectly rendered, staring forward.

SCENE: The monumental face is bursting out from a jagged, massive hole in the side of a brutalist high-rise concrete apartment building. Broken rebar and concrete chunks frame the emergence.

ENVIRONMENT: The surrounding building facade is visible, with multiple windows, balconies, external air conditioning units, exposed pipes, and ventilation vents. People are seen on a distant street below, looking up, emphasizing the immense scale.

STYLE: Cinematic, highly detailed photography. Harsh, directional sunlight casts deep shadows, emphasizing the realism of the face and the raw, broken textures of the concrete and rebar. A true-to-life integration.
